visualReview.findings: Move targets the highlighted item. The Content panel exposes Move selected item; room Rotate/Stretch are disabled. A red preview/status explains wall rejection while the saved level remains valid.

limits: Movement stays in the existing room. Use Content room for transfers. Human M4 handling acceptance and M2 hardware performance acceptance remain open. No new audit/hardware capture or commit/push/deployment.
